name: SUNSHINE
confidence: read from a public-domain score, unchecked
reviewNotes: The melody line read from the Timeless Truths score of Sunshine in My Soul (https://library.timelesstruths.org/music/Sunshine_in_My_Soul/, Sunshine_in_My_Soul.xml, whose rights line reads “WORDS: Eliza E. Hewitt, pub.1887. MUSIC: “Sunshine”; John R. Sweney, pub.1887. Public Domain.”), verse and refrain; only the tune was taken, not the harmony. Its opening agrees with hymnary.org's incipit 12356 71233 43252 (https://hymnary.org/tune/sunshine_sweney). Hand fix: in the refrain the score sets “bless-ed” on a quaver triplet (Bb4 Ab4 on “bless”, F4 on “ed”); it is written on the semiquaver grid as two semiquavers and a quaver (Bb4:.25 Ab4:.25 F4:.5). Sweney's dates (1837–1899) and the year 1887 are from the hymnary.org tune page.
